The entity discloses Scope 2 emissions (location-based and market-based) in tCO2e for the reporting period and the preceding period.

warnings.claim: The entity discloses metrics required by applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.
The entity discloses the metrics it uses to measure and monitor each sustainability-related risk or opportunity.
Disclosures include metrics associated with business models, activities or other common features that characterise participation in the entity's industry.

For any entity-developed metric disclosed, the entity provides the metric definition (including derivation/adjustments and differences vs the source), whether it is absolute/ratio/qualitative, whether it is third-party validated (and by whom), and the calculation method/inputs including significant assumptions and limitations.
The entity provides comparative information for the preceding period for all amounts disclosed.

When a disclosed metric amount is estimated and new information provides evidence of circumstances that existed in the preceding period, the entity revises the comparative amount (except as specified in paragraph B51), discloses the difference, and explains the reasons for the revision.
